profile.headline: Building Next-Gen AR/VR & Gaming Solutions | Senior Software Engineer | Unity, Unreal, C#, C++ | Turning Ideas Into Reality
profile.summary:
I’m passionate about building things that push boundaries, whether it’s immersive AR/VR experiences, next-gen games, or cutting-edge medical technology. There’s not a day that goes by where I’m not learning something new or challenging myself with a fresh project. I love taking on complex problems, modernizing codebases, and turning ambitious ideas into real, usable software.

Right now, I’m diving deep into AI, machine learning, and advanced visualization, always looking for ways to apply the latest tech to real-world challenges. I’ve led engineering teams, architected full-stack solutions, and delivered award-winning projects across gaming, simulation, and medical platforms. For me, it’s all about creating innovative software that makes an impact and inspires others.

If you’re interested in AR/VR, medtech, or game development, or just want to geek out over the latest in C#, Unity, or C++, let’s connect!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
I led the design and delivery of advanced software solutions for surgical planning and navigation, combining hands-on engineering, technical leadership, and cross-functional teamwork. My focus was driving innovation, performance, and reliability in a fast-paced medtech environment.

Key Achievements:
 * Integrated advanced imaging SDKs, enabling complex 2D/3D registration and real-time tracking for proprietary medical applications.

 * Implemented major C++ and Qt application features, including user interface enhancements and flexible configuration systems.

 * Built robust logging and diagnostic tools, boosting application stability and support efficiency.

 * Coordinated efforts between engineering, clinical, and product teams to hit project goals and stay on schedule.

 * Championed team knowledge sharing, process improvements, and the onboarding of new technologies.

I consistently delivered high-quality results, supported team growth, and helped advance the company’s mission to push the boundaries of surgical technology.

projects.title: Mission Moonbound
projects.description:
Mission Moonbound is a simulation game designed to illustrate the physical challenges and health risks faced by astronauts on the lunar surface. The game immerses players in the experience of navigating the moon while coping with reduced gravity, simulating real-world issues such as osteoporosis, muscle loss, and movement difficulties.

My Role:
I designed and developed core gameplay mechanics in Unity and C#, focusing on realistic movement, environmental hazards, and health-based limitations to authentically reflect the effects of long-term lunar exposure.

Highlights:

    Developed simulation systems to model astronaut health issues like bone density loss and muscle atrophy

    Implemented physics-driven movement and lunar gravity effects for authentic gameplay

    Created environmental hazards and mission objectives tied to real astronaut scenarios

    Designed engaging educational experiences to raise awareness about human spaceflight challenges

Play Mission Moonbound on Itch.io
https://savion210.itch.io/mission-moon-bound

projects.title: ExoNauts
projects.description: ExoNauts is a VR Exogame project featuring a series of immersive, physically interactive mini-games. I designed and developed a fast-paced, full-body motion game mode where players wield two swords to strike at flying orbs that dynamically evade player attacks. The challenge is to react quickly, improving both speed and coordination. The game supports up to 4 players, each collaborating in real time to maximize the team score before the timer runs out.
